items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: George Nelson was saxophone player, George Nelson was saxophone player

ctx.x: No, we had Reuben Oliver then. Reuben Oliver was playing. He was a banjo player. Banjo. Oh, man. That same big fellow on bass, I can't get his name. I can't call his name either. Well, thank Kevin. I can't call his name either, cause he was on the boat, but I don't know what it's up. And this boy, trombone player, played sax, one trombone player on one sax, we just call people's names. George, uh, one with the sax and one trombone player, they would sit up on the boat there a while, too. Talk about Nelson, Nelson…
Nelson, George Nelson George Nelson was saxophone player, George Nelson was saxophone player, and Nelson Jones was a trombone player.
And a drummer then would be, uh, well Wills was playing a drummer on a boat with me. with me. Yeah, Will's came on a boat. So, let's see if I got that straight or not.
